title: Priests
summary: Priests served in Israel’s worship, offering sacrifices, guarding holy service, teaching the law, and representing the people in appointed ways.
background: The priesthood belonged to the line of Aaron under the Mosaic covenant. New Testament teaching uses priesthood language to show both continuity and fulfillment in the superior priesthood of Christ.
teachingHelp: In teaching priesthood passages, keep the distinction between Aaronic priests and Christ’s once-for-all high-priestly work clear.
sources: Alfred Edersheim, The Temple: Its Ministry and Services as They Were at the Time of Jesus Christ (1881).
International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
